usedFor: WIX holds the site and orders, Sangam CRM holds leads, and “New Form Response” can start “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Response” in WIX, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A submitted WIX form reaches Sangam CRM as a lead, matched by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Order Updated” in WIX fires on every order change, so “Create or Update Lead” can run many times per order.
